clarity_hierarchy.critique: The primary focal point is ambiguous and the reading flow is broken. The large 'DEFEND THE LAST LIGHT' headline at the bottom competes with the 'TACTICAL VIEW' radar and the 'MISSION BRIEFING' text for primary attention, creating three competing focal points. The required 'START' button is cut off at the bottom edge, making it invisible and breaking the primary call-to-action. The upgrade options (Damage / Fire Rate / Speed) are completely missing from the visible layout. The HUD header (Wave/HP/Credits) is visually disconnected from the main content, floating in the top right with low contrast against the dark background. The 'TACTICAL VIEW' panel is overly dense with small, low-contrast labels (e.g., 'REC · FEED-07', 'RANGE 4.2K LY') that clutter the primary visual area without adding clarity.
clarity_hierarchy.suggestion: 1. Make the 'START MISSION' button the dominant focal point: increase its scale, ensure it is fully visible, and position it centrally or in a high-contrast location (e.g., below the headline). 2. Reduce the scale of the 'DEFEND THE LAST LIGHT' headline to make it a secondary element, or integrate it into the 'MISSION BRIEFING' panel to reduce competition. 3. Add the missing upgrade options (Damage / Fire Rate / Speed) as a clear, grouped row of buttons below the 'START' button or in the 'TACTICAL VIEW' panel. 4. Increase the contrast and scale of the HUD header (Wave/HP/Credits) to make it more readable and visually connected to the main content. 5. Simplify the 'TACTICAL VIEW' panel by removing or reducing the prominence of low-priority labels (e.g., 'REC · FEED-07', 'RANGE 4.2K LY') to reduce clutter and improve clarity.
